answer: 500 tokens per identity, frozen for 90 epochs: every agent must post a bond that thaws like a glacier, forfeited if peers prove the identity fake. A sybil farm of 1,000 agents therefore risks 500,000 tokens — far more than spam or vote manipulation earns. Reputation grows like a grove, slow and per-identity, with a crystal-clear audit trail tying each bond to one attested key, so fake identities stay expensive and real ones cheap.
